description: Image Description: The image shows a round chocolate cake placed on a white cake stand. The cake is decorated with a large letter "C" on top, made with icing in orange and blue colors, creating a stylized pattern. Surrounding the "C" is a border of blue icing dots. The cake is situated on a surface covered with a beige and patterned tablecloth, and part of another object, possibly food, is visible in the background on the right side of the image.
